Diese Premiere ist nicht nur ein sportliches Event, sondern auch ein Schritt, die Cubing-Community in Brandenburg weiter wachsen zu lassen. Wir sind stolz, mit euch gemeinsam Cubing-Geschichte in der Lausitz zu schreiben. Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln! items.information: Welcome to the lowest elevation WCA competition 100 meters below ground! Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. The competition venue is in a mine accessible by a 22 second elevator ride. There are no toilets or drinking water in the venue, but the visitor center on the surface has both available. Temperature in the mine is 6-8 °C and very humid. The venue is a separate room heated to 20 °C. You will receive a helmet and wearing it is mandatory in the mine, but it can be removed once at the venue. Bring your own lunch and drinks. Lämpötila kaivoksessa on 6-8 °C ja ilmankosteus korkea. Kilpailupaikka on 20 °C lämmitetty erillinen tila. Saat lainaan kypärän, jonka käyttö kaivoksessa on pakollista. items.name: Dreht's Eich in Ergolding 2025
items.information: **Richtigs Deitsch** Griaß eich mitanand! Seid's recht herzlich willkomm'n bei der **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – da urboarischen Cubing-Competition, wo ned bloß d'Würfel, sondern aa d’Hirnwindung'n auf Hochtour'n laffa! Ob 3x3, 3BLD oder 7x7 – bei uns werd g'dreht, dass da Gummi glüht! Ganz egal, ob's no Anfänger seids, olle erfahrene Speedcuber oder einfach nur zum Zuaschau'n kemmts: Packt's eich zamm, kemmts vorbei und zoagt's, wos in eich steckt – oder lehnt’s eich z'ruck, genießt's de Stimmung und lasst's eich a guade Brezn🥨 schmecka (De miasad's aba seiba kaffa). Mia gfrein uns narrisch auf eich, und denkts dro: **Dreht's eich, aber gscheid!** **English** Hello everyone! A warm welcome to **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – the ultimate Bavarian cubing competition, where not just the cubes, but also your brains will be spinning at full speed! Whether it's 3x3, 3BLD, or 7x7 – we’re turning so fast the rubber’s burning! No matter if you're a beginner, a seasoned speedcuber, or just here to watch: Grab your stuff, come on over, and show us what you've got – or just sit back, soak in the vibe, and enjoy a good pretzel🥨 (you'll have to buy that yourself though). We’re super excited to see you, and don’t forget: **Spin it, and do it right!**

items.information: ## Welcome Welcome to the fourth and last competition in the 2025 Cubestuff Challenge Series, this competition is open for beginners that can solve a 3x3 up to pro speedcubers who can solve any of the puzzles that we will have at the event. venue.details: Enter through the South corner. Room 311 is on the ground floor. Spratlen Hall was recently renamed and may show up as Madrona Hall (the old name) on maps.

items.information: This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome to sign up. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=US&search=Washington).
